title: org.projectfile.health extension (v1)
description: Standalone contract for the value at the org.projectfile.health subtree: how to tell that a running service works. Two signals, each a check: `readiness` (it can take work now; failing it only withholds work) and `liveness` (it is alive at all; failing it means restart it). The project-level pair applies to every `kind: service` artifact in org.projectfile.artifacts, so a shared include can declare an image family’s checks once; `artifacts.<name>` overrides either signal for one artifact. A reader MUST NOT treat a failing readiness check as a reason to restart, and MUST NOT run a liveness check that is absent: no liveness check means the program is trusted to exit on its own when it breaks.

artifacts.description: Per-artifact overrides, keyed by the artifact’s name in org.projectfile.artifacts. A signal set here replaces the project-level one for that artifact; a signal left out inherits it.

check.description: One check. It passes when the command exits 0 inside the running service, with no shell in between.

command.description: The program and its arguments, exec form (`[readycheck.d]`). Never a shell string: a reader runs it as given.
